about: Can't Argue With That is a three-panel stick figure comic. In the first panel a smiling figure raises a finger, ready to object. In the second its face scrunches into a frustrated frown and the finger droops as it realizes there's no comeback. In the third, it's just a tiny stick figure walking away in defeat. The comic captures the moment a statement is so technically correct, or so absurdly logical, that there's nothing left to say.
origin: The earliest known copy was shared on Flickr in 2009, and the original creator is not known. It later spread as a reaction image on forums and Reddit.
usage:
The first box sits in the white space above the comic and holds the statement that can't be argued with, usually a technically true or flawlessly lazy piece of logic. The second box sits over the bottom panel where the figure walks off; it's optional and often left blank, though a short "...fair enough" works.

It's perfect for shower thoughts, loophole logic, and life hacks that are correct in the most annoying way: if you never go to the gym, you can never skip leg day. Keep the statement short so it reads in one breath before the eye moves down the panels.
ideas: if you never go to the gym you can never skip leg day
if you don't check your bank account, you're technically not broke
the bug isn't a bug if you call it a feature
you can't fail the test if you never take the class
can't lose ranked if you only play casual
